description: ERC-721 facts for one token: owner, collection name and symbol, tokenURI, and its metadata (name, description, image) when the URI is http(s) or ipfs. The metadata fetch has a 5-second timeout and a 256 KB cap; a failed fetch is reported in metadataNote and does not fail the call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
